top_signals.title: Saudis Report Million-Barrel Output Rebound in July to OPEC
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia reported to OPEC that it increased crude oil production by just over 1 million barrels a day last month, a reflection of the recovery among Persian Gulf producers during a brief ceasefire in the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
